SET execution_status = 'sent'
WHERE id = {{ $('Register quarantine pending').item.json.id }}
RETURNING
    id,
    incident_id,
    execution_status,
    target_path,
    target_sha256;

SELECT
    a.id AS action_id,
    a.incident_id,
    a.target_path,
    a.target_sha256,
    a.execution_status,
    a.created_at,
    i.agent_source,
    i.risk_score,
    i.criticality
FROM actions_taken a
JOIN incidents i
    ON i.id = a.incident_id
WHERE a.action_type = 'quarantine_file'

  AND a.execution_status IN ('pending', 'sent')

  AND LOWER(a.target_path) =
      LOWER('{{ $('Interact with Wazuh').item.json.body.all_fields.syscheck.path.replace(/'/g, "''") }}')

  AND i.agent_source =
      '{{ $('Interact with Wazuh').item.json.body.all_fields.agent.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'

  AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'

ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE actions_taken

WHERE id = {{ $('Find matching quarantine').item.json.action_id }}
RETURNING

    incident_id,
    target_path,
    target_sha256,
    execution_status;

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE ioc_cache
    SET
        type = 'ip',
        source = 'Wazuh',
        verdict = 'brute_force',
        reputation_score = {{ $('Prepare Brute Force Data').item.json.risk_score }}
    WHERE value = '{{ $('Prepare Brute Force Data').item.json.attacker_ip }}'
    RETURNING id
),
inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO ioc_cache (
        value,
        type,
        source,
        verdict,
        reputation_score
    )
    SELECT
        '{{ $('Prepare Brute Force Data').item.json.attacker_ip }}',
        'ip',
        'Wazuh',
        'brute_force',
        {{ $('Prepare Brute Force Data').item.json.risk_score }}
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM updated
    )
    RETURNING id
)

SELECT id FROM updated
UNION ALL
SELECT id FROM inserted
LIMIT 1;
